about: Jio Platforms is a technology platform built on proprietary digital technology with pan-India digital connectivity as its base layer. Through its subsidiary Reliance Jio Infocomm (RJIL) it served 533.3 million customers in India as of June 30, 2026, offering mobile, fixed broadband and digital services including entertainment, cloud and AI products. Reliance Industries Limited is its parent company.

promoters.background: Reliance Industries Limited is the parent company and Promoter; it owns the Jio trademark licensed to the company.

concentration.note: Reliance Retail Limited is the sole distributor of pre-paid connectivity services, which were 77.08% of consolidated revenue from operations in FY26. RJIL contributed 87.74% of FY26 consolidated revenue.

strengths: Largest digital connectivity player in India: 533.3 million RJIL customers, including 284.9 million 5G customers, as of June 30, 2026.
Carried about 60% of India's wireless data traffic in Fiscal 2026, with about 1.4 times the 4G+5G subscribers of the second largest player.
High profitability: FY26 EBITDA margin of 51.91% and PAT margin of 20.46% on revenue of Rs 146,885 crore.
Revenue and EBITDA grew at 15.79% and 17.79% CAGR between Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2026.
Improving balance sheet: net leverage fell from 0.88x in Fiscal 2024 to 0.36x in Fiscal 2026.
Proprietary full-stack technology with 7,220 patent applications filed; end-to-end 5G standalone stack deployed at nationwide scale.
Largest fixed broadband provider in India with 28.6 million JioFiber/JioAirFiber customers and 61.73% share of net fixed broadband additions in the June 2026 quarter.
Holds 26,800.8 MHz of spectrum across low, mid and millimetre-wave bands, with about 15.8 years average remaining life.

risks.title: Sole distributor dependence on Reliance Retail
risks.detail: Reliance Retail Limited is the sole distributor of pre-paid services, which made up 77.08% of FY26 consolidated revenue from operations (79.35% in FY24). Any disruption would hit revenue.

risks.title: Heavy related-party dealings with the Reliance Group
risks.detail: Promoter owns 66.43% pre-Issue. Revenue received in advance from Reliance Retail via recharge vouchers was Rs 1,129,351 million in FY26; transactions may not be on terms available from unrelated parties.

risks.title: Licence and spectrum renewal
risks.detail: RJIL's unified licence is due for renewal in October 2033 and spectrum is valid for 20 years with the majority expiring later; failure to renew or win spectrum would hurt operations.

risks.title: Significant indebtedness and deferred payments
risks.detail: Net leverage is 0.36x, but deferred payment liabilities were Rs 1,045,137 million and lease liabilities Rs 138,876 million at March 31, 2026; Rs 275,000 million of IPO proceeds will prepay RJIL borrowings.

risks.title: Overdependence on RJIL
risks.detail: RJIL contributed 87.74% of FY26 revenue, 94.88% of EBITDA and 93.76% of PAT; any deterioration at RJIL hits consolidated results.

risks.title: Highly regulated telecom business
risks.detail: Operations are subject to TRAI and DoT regulation of licensing, spectrum and tariffs; non-compliance may lead to suspension, non-renewal or additional payments, and net neutrality rules apply.

risks.title: Reliance on passive infrastructure and vendors
risks.detail: The company does not own passive infrastructure such as towers and optic fibre and relies on a limited group of providers and a limited number of vendors, including related parties, for network equipment.

risks.title: Intense competition and capital intensity
risks.detail: The market is highly competitive and the business needs heavy capex for spectrum and networks; FY26 ARPU was Rs 214.0 per month and satellite broadband may add competition.

notes: Source is the RHP; price band, issue price, P/E and post-issue shares are blank. Amounts converted from Rs million to crore. Q1 FY27 (June 2026) quarter ignored in arrays. PAT is Profit for the year per the KPI table (after share of associate/JV loss). Net worth and reserves computed from the equity statement as share capital plus reserves and surplus excluding OCI (NAV Rs 373.66 reconciles). Cash and bank is cash equivalents plus other bank balances. Borrowings are current plus non-current borrowings (excluding leases and deferred payment liabilities). Fresh issue of up to 270,000,000 shares; no offer for sale stated in the objects section.
